notablePrerequisites: Cephalid Illusionist does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Declare Cephalid Illusionist as an attacker.
Holding priority, activate Reconnaissance by paying {0}, targeting Cephalid Illusionist.
Cephalid Illusionist triggers, causing you to mill three cards.
Repeat from step 2.
Resolve all Reconnaissance abilities.
